51526421.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal His6/SUMO-tagged full length human ATG4B expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - 4.7. Surface pla: The SPR assay was performed to measure the binding affinity of ATG4B and DC-ATG4in on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. The ATG4B protein was coupled to the CM5 chip (GE Healthcare) to attain an optical density of 8000 RU based on a standard amine coupling protocol at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The path without coupled ATG4B protein serves as a control reference. The compound of DC-ATG4in was dissolved in SPR buffer (20 mM HEPES pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 % v/v DMSO) and diluted in different concentrations ranging from 5.2 μM to 200 μM. The last concentration of 0 μM serves as a compound control. Then the DC-ATG4in compound was injected at a flow rate of 30 μL/min to bind with immobilized protein for 180 s and dissociated for 250 s. Finally, the Kd value of DC-ATG4in against ATG4B protein was obtained by Biacore T200 software Version 1.0 to evaluate the binding affinity.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption - F: SPR sensorgram showing the direct binding activity between DC-ATG4in with ATG4B protein.
original_paragraph.Figure 2F: The SPR sensorgram (Figure 2F) shows the response units (RU) over time (s) for different concentrations of DC-ATG4in: 5.2 μM, 7.8 μM, 11.7 μM, 17.6 μM, 39.5 μM, 59.3 μM, 133.3 μM, and 200 μM. The x-axis ranges from -200 to 600 seconds, and the y-axis (Response Unit(RU)) ranges from 0 to 150. The Kd value is reported as 14.33 ± 1.52 μM.

immobilization.ligand_name: N-terminal His6/SUMO-tagged full length human ATG4B
